title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manipulating moving objects requires a policy to anticipate contact events, yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly fine-tuned from the current observation alone. World action models (WAMs) learn predictive dynamics, but running a video-scale teacher or explicitly imagining future frames at deployment is costly. We introduce ForeTime-VLA, a dense pi0.5 policy that distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM-derived teacher while remaining causal at inference. Offline, current and future video latents are compressed into a whitened 64-D target. Online, an eight-frame history encoder predicts this target together with manipulation phase and normalized time-to-transition. Four future tokens and one phase token condition the VLM prefix, while the predicted future and transition horizon condition the action expert. translated_title: ForeTime-VLA：从世界动作模型进行因果未来令牌蒸馏用于传送带操作
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20735v1 公告类型：新 摘要：操作移动物体需要策略预测接触事件，然而视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常仅从当前观测进行微调。世界动作模型（WAMs）学习预测动力学，但在部署时运行视频规模的教师模型或显式想象未来帧成本高昂。我们引入了ForeTime-VLA，一种密集的pi0.5策略，它从冻结的Fast-WAM派生教师模型中蒸馏出未来感知、动作等价表示，同时在推理时保持因果性。离线时，当前和未来视频潜在表示被压缩为白化的64维目标。在线时，一个八帧历史编码器预测该目标以及操作阶段和归一化转换时间。四个未来令牌和一个阶段令牌条件化VLM前缀，而预测的未来和转换视界条件化动作专家。训练保留原始流匹配动作目标，并添加余弦、重...
tldr: 本文提出ForeTime-VLA，通过从世界动作模型蒸馏未来感知表示，实现因果推理下的传送带移动物体操作，显著提升接触事件预测效率。
en_tdlr: ForeTime-VLA distills future-aware representations from a world action model for causal conveyor-belt manipulation, enhancing contact prediction without costly future-frame generation.
